experiment: Frozen temporal choice audit consistency replay
retrieval_source: Stage243 saved per-question results; the deterministic resolver read each saved Top-20 input
decision: Keep the resolver opt-in. It abstains only when a user-cited temporal audit explicitly says the two options cannot be compared because one event is undocumented. This frozen saved-answer replay is not a fresh full benchmark score.
limitations: One changed answer was live-judged; the other 132 saved judgments were unchanged. The full Stage243 score remains 438/500 (87.6%), and memory precision was not measured.
